chunks: My father (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Sa'd b. 'Abdullah narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Husayn b. Abu'l Khattab narrated to us from Nasr b. Muzahim al-Munqari from 'Umar b. Sa'd from Abu Shu'ayb al-Taghlabi from Yahya b. Yaman from a leader of Banu Sulaym from their elders.

They said: We invaded the lands of Rome and entered a church from their churches. We found written therein: Does a congregation that killed Husayn hope for the intercession of his grandfather on the Day of Reckoning?
They said: So we asked: Since when has this been in your church? They said: Three hundred years before your Prophet was sent.

key_terms.شفاعة: shafa'ah — intercession, particularly the Prophet's intercession on the Day of Judgment
key_terms.كنيسة: church — a Christian place of worship
key_terms.يبعث: to be raised/sent as a prophet — referring to the prophetic mission of Muhammad
key_terms.يوم الحساب: Day of Reckoning — the Day of Judgment when all deeds are accounted for

ai.seo_question: What inscription about Imam Husayn was found in a Roman church?
ai.summary: Muslim soldiers on a military expedition into Byzantine territory discover an extraordinary inscription inside a church — a verse of poetry condemning the killers of Husayn and questioning whether they could hope for the Prophet's intercession. When they ask the Christians how long this inscription had been there, they are told it predates the mission of Prophet Muhammad by three hundred years, suggesting that Husayn's martyrdom was foreknown even in pre-Islamic Christian scripture.

en.bilal-muhammad: My father (ra) narrated to us. He said: Sa`d b. `Abdullah narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Husayn b. Abu’l Khattab narrated to us from Nasr b. Mazahim al-Munqari from `Umar b. Sa`d from Abu Shu`ayb al-Taghlabi from Yahya b. Yaman from a leader of Banu Sulaym from their elders.

They said: We invaded the cities of Rome and entered a church from their churches. We found written therein: Does the congregation that killed Husayn hope [for the] intercession of his grandfather on the Day of Reckoning?
They said: So, we asked: Since when has this been in your church? They said: Three hundred years prior to the raising of your Prophet.
